public_dataset_version: ACOUSLIC-AI Zenodo 12697994 v1.1 training release only
primary_endpoint: subject-mean best annotation WFSS among 12 acquired clean frames
action_space: any unseen center 000..839; three nearest unseen frames within its sweep
recognition_gate: at least six tuning subjects with controls; accuracy and both-order stability meet thresholds
checkpoint_rule: final update 32 for every arm; no held-out checkpoint selection
win_target: rl_full at least +0.10 WFSS over the strongest simple comparator; report simultaneous paired subject-bootstrap intervals against standard baselines and pre_rl_full
inference_rule: RL superiority requires positive paired uncertainty bounds versus standard baselines and matched pre-RL warm start; history benefit is a separate comparison
heldout_policy: freeze all arm checkpoints before one evaluation; do not revise the method after inspecting held-out outcomes
limitations: one training seed and 20 held-out subjects; annotation zeros are not verified anatomical negatives; acquisition is not clinical diagnosis
